'''Vassek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] apprentice of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Khreusis]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was present when his master was confronted by [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who sought to acquire [[Kallig's Countenance|his mask]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vassek appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
